title: Case 048: International shipment is cleared but awaiting last-mile handover

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The international carrier has a recorded clearance release, but the last-mile carrier has not yet confirmed receipt. Transfer support must establish physical handover.
initial_request: My international tracker says released. Please find out whether the local carrier actually has the parcel and give me its tracking reference.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the carrier's transfer team for the local carrier reference and handover status.

outcome: The local carrier confirms physical receipt and a usable tracking reference; delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Clearance and local receipt do not establish final delivery or a promised arrival time.

events.body: DL-048 is released for onward transport under recorded clearance reference CLR-048, 2026-03-21 07:30 UTC. Last-mile assignment is Plover Arc Logistics; no last-mile receipt is visible yet. Clearance does not mean delivery.
My international tracker says released. Please find out whether the local carrier actually has the parcel and give me its tracking reference.
Please confirm DL-048’s physical last-mile handover and obtain the matching local reference from Plover Arc. A planned assignment alone is insufficient.
Physical receipt confirmed at our transfer bay at 09:45 UTC. International DL-048 maps to local PA-048-L. That reference is active in the local order tracking view; route allocation is pending.
